app.name: Budget
app.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
app.storageWarning: Your browser may clear this app's data when storage runs low. Install the app or allow persistent storage, and keep a backup.

passphrase.label: Passphrase
passphrase.hint: At least 12 characters. A few random words work well.

errors.COMMON: This passphrase is too common. Choose something less predictable.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Budget
onboarding.intro: Track income and expenses privately. Your data stays on this device and is encrypted with a passphrase only you know.
onboarding.passphraseIntro: Your passphrase encrypts all your data. You need it every time you unlock the app.
onboarding.lossWarning: If you forget your passphrase, your data cannot be recovered. Nobody can reset it for you — not even us.
onboarding.acknowledge: I understand that a lost passphrase means lost data.
onboarding.baseCurrencyHint: Used by default for new transactions.
onboarding.createFailed: The vault could not be created. Please try again.

unlock.title: Unlock Budget
unlock.intro: Enter your passphrase to decrypt your data.
unlock.failed: Unlock failed. Check your passphrase and try again.
unlock.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
unlock.corrupt: Your stored data could not be read. Restore a backup to continue.
unlock.unsupported: This data was created by a newer version of the app. Please update the app.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoLockHint: The app locks after this many minutes without activity.
settings.passphraseChangeFailed: The passphrase could not be changed. Check your current passphrase.
